title: Gideon and the Well
author: Xanthe Dravenmoor
blurb: Quentin Eriksen, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
